overall_assessment: Nord's uniform page structure gives mostly correct sections; most pre-pass flags (short, empty, leak->reading_list) are false alarms. Real problems are coursework requirements (Arbeidskrav) landing in teaching_methods or assessment when they sit outside the standard Eksamensbeskrivelse lines, duplicated/boilerplate prerequisites, and one course whose whole exam text is filed as coursework.

findings.evidence: 1) Innlevering av et antall obligatoriske multiple choice tester. Hver enkelt test MÅ leveres inn innen gitt tidsfrist.
findings.description: Arbeidskrav (pass/approve gates) are filed under another section. In MET2000 the whole 'Arbeidskrav:' block written inside Læringsaktiviteter ends up in teaching_methods (the flagged leak->coursework_requirements is real). In PRO9011 (both semesters) the English 'Coursework requirements:' block (presentation 0/100 of the grade, approved/not approved) stays in assessment and no coursework_requirements row is produced. In VIT5012 an 'AK/ Arbeidskrav' line also sits in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Section split is by page heading only. Arbeidskrav lines are separated out of Eksamensbeskrivelse by Norwegian line-prefix patterns (Arbeidskrav -, Obligatorisk deltakelse), which miss the 'Coursework requirements:' header, the 'AK/' prefix and a labelled block inside the teaching-methods section. Nothing separates arbeidskrav from teaching text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections()/sectionize() add a block-level rule: a paragraph starting 'Arbeidskrav:', 'Coursework requirements:' or 'AK/' (and the following paragraphs up to the next blank-separated non-arbeidskrav paragraph) moves to coursework_requirements, whatever section it was read in, including teaching_methods.

findings.description: The whole one-line Eksamensbeskrivelse names both the arbeidskrav and the graded home exam, but the extractor emitted it only as coursework_requirements. There is no assessment row, so the graded exam (hjemmeeksamen, 3 days) is lost from assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The line-level arbeidskrav classifier moves any line starting with 'Arbeidskrav' to coursework_requirements, without checking that the line also describes a graded exam.
findings.suggested_fix: When the entire assessment text would be moved to coursework_requirements, or the line contains exam words (eksamen, hjemmeeksamen, oppgave), keep it in assessment too (or only move lines with no exam keyword).

findings.evidence: Candidates who intend to sit for exams must have completed the master's degree in a relevant field.
findings.description: Prerequisites repeat the same passage twice (once from Forkunnskapskrav and again from Anbefalte forkunnskaper, with slightly different wording) and include the 'Before the first meeting the candidates shall write an abstract (300 words)' preparatory task, which is a course requirement rather than a prerequisite. The abstract paragraph also appears twice.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page repeats the same text under two prerequisite headings (Forkunnskapskrav and Anbefalte forkunnskaper), both mapped to prerequisites and concatenated without de-duplication.
findings.suggested_fix: De-duplicate near-identical paragraphs within a section in .clean_sections() (normalised-text or high-similarity match). Optionally route the 'Abstract' paragraph to coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Studenter må oppfylle gjeldene opptakskrav ved tilhørende studieprogram.
findings.description: Forkunnskapskrav sometimes holds only admission wording (opptakskrav, tatt opp som student, bachelorgrad for opptak), not a knowledge prerequisite, so prerequisites carries admission text. Other courses' 'Det kreves ingen forkunnskaper' / 'Se informasjon om opptakskrav' show the same pattern.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Forkunnskapskrav is mapped to prerequisites unconditionally; no boilerplate filter for admission phrasing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add admission/opptakskrav phrases ('oppfylle gjeldende opptakskrav', 'tatt opp som student', 'Se informasjon om opptakskrav', 'ingen forkunnskap utover opptakskravet') to the boilerplate/.drop list for prerequisites, and treat the row as empty when nothing else remains. Must fit course_plan_spec.md.

findings.evidence: Det tas forbehold om endringer i vurderingsform. Korrekte vurderingsform vises i StudentWeb ved oppmelding til aktuelt emne.
findings.description: Assessment contains admin boilerplate (StudentWeb notice), a stray merged sub-heading line 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen' with the aid text and the AI-cheating notice, and in PRO9011 autumn a term-specific logistics line ('submission deadline Thursday in Wiseflow'). These are exam logistics/boilerplate, not assessment design.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Hjelpemidler til eksamen is mapped to assessment and appended with its heading line kept in the text; no boilerplate pattern for the StudentWeb notice.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the heading line 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen' (and optionally drop the aids paragraph per spec), and add the 'Det tas forbehold om endringer i vurderingsform ... StudentWeb' sentence and 'submission deadline ... Wiseflow' lines to the assessment boilerplate list.
